result: Stationary KMS quantum environments generically relate symmetric noise and dissipative/retarded response; the relation is not gravity-specific.
scope_guardrail: Do not impose equilibrium KMS/FDR on arbitrary nonstationary, squeezed, driven or nonequilibrium states.
kg_lesson: Use FDR/KMS as a state-sector consistency/rigidity relation only; gravity attribution still requires spin-2/tensor/universal-stress-energy structure.
